title: Ecgberht durable handback-file contract (skill-owned)
description: SKILL-OWNED durable handback-file protocol (North Star criterion 15, Wave 4). Every executor (Anchor reference executor = implementation #1; in-session executor = implementation #2) MUST implement this contract. The handback JSON body is validated by the EXISTING receipt-validate.mjs (kind=handback) — this schema covers the on-disk envelope, path convention, terminal marker, write discipline, and idempotence — not a second receipt validator. Refuted e-1 (new handback artifact channel) stays dead: this is the EXISTING bundle/receipt made restart-safe.

contract_version.description: Version pin. Wave-21 conformance suite fails if executors disagree on contract_version.

handback_rel_dir.description: Directory inside the run's worktree where the handback pair lives.

handback_json_name.description: Filename of the handback JSON (receipt shape; validated by receipt-validate.mjs).

terminal_marker_name.description: Filename of the terminal marker. Presence means the handback write completed durably.

write_discipline.description: S6: each file is written temp + fsync + rename (atomic replace) in the target directory.

single_writer.description: One writer per run dir by construction — a contract clause binding every executor.

marker_absent_means.description: If the terminal marker is absent, the pair is NOT ingestable (even if handback.json is present).

idempotence_key.description: Ingestion is idempotent on client_event_id (exactly-once adopt).

semantics.description: Re-delivery of the same client_event_id is a no-op after first successful ingest.

receipt_validator.description: No new validator — handback JSON must pass validateReceipt (kind=handback).

write_order.description: Normative write order: handback.json first, then TERMINAL.marker. Marker last is what makes kill-mid-write safe.

no_credential_in_child.description: Descope D-1: child env/argv must never carry ANCHOR_TOKEN or a capability secret.
